summary: A heartbroken narrator begs for a little love to mend the pain and hold them together.
A party-all-night anthem about letting loose on the dance floor and owning the night.
Boasting about a rise from the bottom to the top, with money, cars and cash, and raw swagger.
Nostalgic memories of small-town teenage life, first loves and simple hometown pleasures.
A chilly-night romantic plea to share warmth, with dreams of the world and travel.
Two lovers drive through the night after a kiss, refusing to end the magic and go home.
A nightclub pickup pitch bragging about wealth and sports status while urging a fresh romance.
An upbeat ode to a love that feels better than anything, with dance floor call-outs.
A jilted groom drinks through his honeymoon flight, mocking his ex and drowning the pain.
A flirtatious invitation promising a sweet, celebratory night and a birthday every day.
A woman goes out drinking with friends to forget a breakup and let the memories fade.
Tuning out a preachy critic by covering the ears and drowning out their hypocritical speech.
Defiant reply to public judgment, claiming control over one's body, image and fame.
Cannot shake a lover despite repeated mistakes, longing for one remembered kiss under the moon.
A grieving ex wishes for amnesia to erase memories of a girl who left and moved on.
Boastful ode to glamorous, high-maintenance women and wealth, rejecting anything ordinary.
A restless, fearful call to escape the everyday and lose control on a wild night.
Bragging about loyalty, street status, wealth and a rise from humble beginnings with the crew.
A club-night anthem about dancing in sneakers, partying hard and showing off style.
Laid-back summer beach day with a girl, cold drinks and a reggae band in the sun.
Cruising in a classic Cadillac with a roof off, bragging about style and easy living on the road.
A cheeky pop-punk pitch to run away from a dull town with a girl and a mix tape.
Two lovers who keep burning out admit they know it is no lifelong bond, asking to stay the night.
A bold, playful club anthem about fame, desire and public image, with a chauffeur gag.
A sexually forward studio song promising a night together while bragging about a sweet bad girl.
Boasting about rising from the grind to the top, rivals, fame and a big-money comeback.
A man who never settled down admits he cannot dance but would do anything to spin with his love.
A reckless night out with a stranger, drinking and making a getaway to New Orleans with cash.
A giddy, love-struck singer says she has just started living and adores her partner.
A high-energy party track bragging about style, nightlife and a dance-floor takeover.
A devoted promise of lifelong love, imagining growing old together and still falling in love.
A tribute to a departed friend, promising to share every story again when they meet once more.
Flashy bragging about money, a trap-life romance and a woman who runs the hustle with him.
A sweet-talking plea for affection, promising a taste of love and needing sympathy.
A night-out dance floor encounter where a bold girl insists on dancing and a destiny is sealed.
A tongue-in-cheek portrait of a reckless, rumor-filled romance with a long list of exes.
An energetic call-and-response dance challenge telling listeners to watch and copy the moves.
A devoted lover says she will care for her partner, who has earned his love and worth.
A hedonistic, sleazy affair with a cheating partner, told through drugs, sex and guilt.
A flirty ode to a dance-team girlfriend who motivates him and makes him want to settle down.
A lover who is worth any misery, numb and in love despite knowing it will be the end.
A lover pleads to be loved and touched like before, feeling high and lost in the moment.
A heretical, sensual hymn that puts a lover above church, sin and the religious judgment of others.
A bitter feud anthem about a former friend who wronged the narrator and left bad blood.
A breezy summer-night anthem about needing someone to lean on, blending Spanish and English verses.
A hot night of wanting a lover so badly that the narrator would do anything to be near them.
A heartbroken plea to a former lover who vanished when the narrator needed them most.
A stirring self-anthem about refusing to give up, finding strength and fighting for one's life.
Flexing wealth, cars and a gun in the car while chasing a woman and bragging about the crew.
A bitter breakup song calling out a two-faced lover who lies and says the wrong things.
